# Zefr

> Zefr is an ad-tech content intelligence company that classifies social video, image, audio
> and text so advertisers can buy and measure media against brand safety and suitability
> standards. Its classification engine labels content across YouTube, Meta (Facebook and
> Instagram), TikTok, Snapchat, Google Ads and DV360 against the 4A's and GARM frameworks,
> and its Brand Suitability Suite lets brands apply pre-bid controls and post-bid measurement
> from one place.

**This file is generated by API Evangelist, not published by Zefr.** Zefr serves no `llms.txt`
on any host it controls (`https://zefr.com/llms.txt` → 404). It is assembled from Zefr's own
public pages and from the artifacts in this repository so an agent has a grounded starting
point. Anything Zefr has not published is marked as absent below rather than invented.

## API status

Zefr has **no public developer program**. As of 2026-08-12 there is no developer portal, no
API reference, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, no SDK, no CLI, no MCP server and no
agent card at any Zefr-controlled host. `developer.zefr.com` and `docs.zefr.com` do not
resolve. Production API infrastructure demonstrably exists — `api.zefr.com` is a Google
Apigee gateway, alongside `api2.zefr.com` and `api-eu1.zefr.com` — but no proxy resolves for
any anonymous caller and nothing about it is documented publicly. Access runs through a sales
conversation.

## Identity

- [OpenID Connect discovery](https://login.zefr.com/.well-known/openid-configuration): Zefr's
  Auth0 custom domain; serves OIDC 1.0 discovery anonymously.
- [OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata](https://login.zefr.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server):
  RFC 8414 metadata for the same issuer.
- [JWKS](https://login.zefr.com/.well-known/jwks.json): signing keys.

Authorization Code with PKCE (S256), client credentials, refresh token, device code and
token exchange grants are advertised; DPoP (ES256) is supported. Only standard OIDC identity
scopes are published — no Zefr product API scopes exist publicly.
